«площадь» — самый узкий угол, при которо: «площадь» (area) — the narrowest angle at which the frame holds the share of the room area given below. «DORI» — so that the detail level given below is reached at the working distance (to the wall, but no farther than the camera range); needs the sensor resolution (section ⑤). «авто» (auto) — DORI if the wall is farther than the camera range (a car park, a warehouse), otherwise area.
